1.consolidated_definition: Casa o edificio donde se reúnen los miembros de un club. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Véase casa club. Disfrutará además de todas las facilidades recreativas y deportivas de Encantada, tales como el club house, sport center, piscinas, canchas de baloncesto, volleyball, parque de pelota, pista de caminar, etc. (Clasificados1.com, 18-12-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Clubhouse or building where members of a club gather. Raw Anglicism, relatively infrequent. See clubhouse. In addition to enjoying all the recreational and sports facilities at Encantada, such as the clubhouse, sport center, pools, basketball courts, volleyball courts, baseball diamond, walking track, etc.
